## Frequently asked questions

### Where is SSK Agencies?
No. 55/2, 100 Feet Road, J.N. Salai, Vadapalani, Chennai 600 026 (Metro Pillar No. 132).

### What facilities does SSK Agencies have?
Kajaria tiles, Kohler sanitary ware, Floor & wall tiles, Parking & elevation tiles, Waterproof & cool roof tiles, Wash basins & closets, Faucets & fittings, Vanity cabinets, Shower enclosures & bath tubs, Kitchen sinks, Our own designed vitrified tiles.

### Which brands do you carry?
We are an authorized Kohler and Kajaria showroom, with other leading tile brands and our own line of designed vitrified tiles.

### Which tile sizes do you stock?
1200 × 2400, 800 × 2400, 1200 × 1200, 800 × 1600, 600 × 1200 and 800 × 800.

### Do you supply across Chennai?
Yes. We supply tiles across the city for homes, apartments, villas, offices, retail spaces, hotels, hospitals and commercial developments.
